title: Enable Mintlify partial authentication for audience separation
description: Provider activation blocker and staged rollout. Current Mintlify documentation indicates groups-based access via MDX groups is available only with OAuth or JWT and therefore requires Enterprise entitlement; verify plan/entitlement before activation. If Enterprise is unavailable, use the documented partial-auth fallback: mark public pages/groups with public: true and leave default-protected pages for all Mintlify organization members, without groups frontmatter; that fallback requires a separate repository access-model change before merge. Preview organization authentication protects all preview routes and cannot replace the anonymous-public acceptance smoke. Staged steps: (1) verify the plan/entitlement; (2) enable organization authentication on PR previews first; (3) establish a public-marker-only baseline or equivalent verified atomic provider rollout because current main lacks explicit public markers; (4) verify deployed partial-auth behavior where public pages return 200 anonymously and restricted pages are protected, plus public-only llms.txt/MCP/search; (5) only then enable production partial auth and admit restricted content. Exact dashboard actions: enable Mintlify Authentication/partial auth for docs.kombify.io, authorize required team users/group when Enterprise supports it, enable organization authentication on PR previews, and verify both audiences. Do not store credentials here or mutate provider settings from the repository.

title: Implement internal/public Mintlify audience separation
description: Implement the Mintlify partial-auth audience boundary in this repository: explicit public markers, kombify-team restricted reviewer route, deterministic static gate, two-view local E2E, CI, workflow documentation, and provider activation blocker.
close_reason: Repository implementation complete; provider activation remains blocked separately.
